change: Removed the experimental Windows network compartment; Windows offers compatibility mode (ProxiFyre path routing) only. Saved compartment apps migrate to compatibility mode. The outbound guard stays off by default after a native measurement showed it blocks path-routed programs.

local_validation.failure_scope: Linux bubblewrap containment tests only; identical failures on unmodified main on the same host (Ubuntu 26.04 restricts unprivileged user namespaces). They pass in the CI matrix below.

known_limitations: Windows per-application ProxiFyre remains path-based, with DNS/IPv6/fault limits; no Linux-equivalent isolation guarantee.
The outbound guard blocks programs that rely on ProxiFyre redirection (WinError 10013 on TCP, UDP timeouts); it only suits applications that use the local proxy themselves and is off by default.
System proxy covers applications honoring current-user WinINet or GNOME gsettings only.
Windows 11 visible-desktop browser phase has never passed in KVM; Windows 11 qualification remains incomplete.

ci_validation.windows_11_native: all 16 routing phases passed; visible Edge window phase timed out after 45 s
ci_validation.app_guard_measurement: guard on: selected and helper TCP WinError 10013, UDP timeout; unselected direct connected; guard off restored routing
ci_validation.check_flaky_rerun: 40307996632 (same commit) had one Windows py3.14 real-Edge timeout in test_real_sandboxed_edge_executes_panel_state_fetch_under_current_token; failed job rerun

post_product_run_changes: README.md and CHANGELOG.md document the outbound guard measurement.
web/index.html adds a warning to the outbound guard description; no execution code changed after the product run.
